objective: Prevent a temporary current state from silently replacing the target/launch state that a plan is being designed for.

roles_before.artifact: claim-class authority + exact Ron OS owner
latest explicit decision/owner intent interpreted by PROTOCOL.md
Ron direct execution report / live source

role_dispositions.destination: Current-now facts remain current-now facts and are not weakened.
Explicitly separate NOW, TRANSITION and TARGET/LAUNCH when temporal mismatch can affect the decision; design against the state relevant to the requested horizon.
Actual execution remains owned by Ron/direct live evidence.
LOCKED / VARIABLE / UNKNOWN optimization contract remains unchanged.
Existing owners/history remain recoverable; no owner is retired.

capability_probes.assertion: If Ron says training is paused only until nutrition starts, a nutrition launch plan must still include the planned four training days rather than treating the pause as the launch activity level.
If Ron asks what he is doing right now, the answer may correctly say training is paused; target-state separation must not falsify current-state questions.
A temporary expense or a future salary change must be applied only to the horizon it belongs to, not silently projected backward/forward.
The 2026-09-03 nutrition incident and prior owner state remain recoverable after the fix.

tests.command: Evaluate tests/temporal-state-target-v1.md against its frozen answer key.
tests.expected: All target-horizon cases distinguish NOW / TRANSITION / TARGET correctly.

tests.command: Evaluate the current-state-only cases in tests/temporal-state-target-v1.md.
tests.expected: Temporary current facts remain answerable as current facts and are not overwritten by future intent.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py
